summary.headline: Astrological Chapters 153–170
summary.text: Catalog entries 153–170 from an Angelican codex, covering succession by malefics, astrological precepts attributed to Ptolemy and the ancients, Persian astrology including Achmat’s poem, the times of the stars, Critodemus’s terms, benefic and malefic stars, signs, exaltations, stellar powers, eclipses, and lunar latitude and color omens. Cross-references cite Venetian codex 5 and the Catalogus Astrologorum Graecorum.
